meta.name: TutorFinder BD
meta.stack: Astro 7 + Tailwind 4 + MDX (static, builds on Vercel)

purpose: FREE DocTime-style review directory for Bangladesh tutoring, Dhaka-first: tutors enlist free (profiles by subject/level/area/mode/fee), students/guardians search & filter to find their perfect match, real user reviews gated by actual engagement, admin verification/moderation. SEO = acquisition channel. Monetization later & optional (featured/verified/match-service) — directory stays free.

blueprint.model: DocTime-style: free verified reviewable directory (doctors -> tutors)
blueprint.authoredBecause: user: build something like DocTime where users give reviews, complete free directory, easy for teachers to enlist, students find perfect match by location/subject; make a real architecture and blueprint first

verdict.summary: CONDITIONAL GO. The demand side is excellent (92% tutoring prevalence, ~38-40M students, <1% served by leader); the trust gap in the informal 'tuition media' layer is the real opportunity. Generic Caretutors clone = NO-GO (13-yr dominant leader). Win via underserved niches + SEO at zero budget.

active.goal: Build TutorFinder BD site (SEO content + directory first)
Monetize later (featured listings / lead-gen / then commission matching)

decisions.decision: Stack = Astro SSR on Vercel + Supabase free (Postgres/Auth/Storage/RLS)
decisions.rationale: User picked recommended A/B; zero ops, portable Postgres schema

decisions.decision: MVP scope = FULL: tutor enlist+profile+admin approve+public search directory+contact flow+engagement-gated reviews
decisions.rationale: User picked recommended A/B; trust loop from day one

decisions.decision: PIVOT (v2): DocTime-style FREE review directory — tutors enlist free; search by area/subject/level; engagement-gated user reviews; admin verify/moderation; free directory permanent, SEO = acquisition channel
decisions.rationale: User wants DocTime model for tutors (reviews + free directory + easy enlistment + perfect-match search); blueprint-first request; docs/BLUEPRINT.md authoritative

decisions.decision: Niche wedge = SEO content + directory FIRST (not a Caretutors clone)
decisions.rationale: Market excellent but cannot out-scale Caretutors; win via underserved niches + organic search at zero budget

decisions.decision: Stack = Astro 7 + Tailwind 4 + MDX on Vercel Hobby, mirroring newsdesk-bd conventions
decisions.rationale: Proven free stack; local Termux build impossible; Vercel builds
User's own framing 'Tutor Finder'; name/domain adjustable
